uplink.description: standard report, endpoint 0 (probe 1): temperature 29.53 C | payload:110A04020000290B89
uplink._note: byte0 0x11 -> endpoint ((0x11 & 0xE0) >> 5) | ((0x11 & 0x06) << 2) = 0. One ZCL standard report carries one endpoint, so the frame yields a single channels[] entry labelled endpoint0. Upstream calls the same value temperature_1. Satisfies the temperature category through the entry.
